content: Lazarus Irabob
Orot wabin Lazarus on Bethany nan imama on isawau. Bethany mafam gagaminai nan on Mary tain tuan Martha rus simama.
(Atonio Mary on ainau fio yanden ninibin on ibo Iesu annai idebur isur ato toun tefanai nan ann isafanen, on jever robun Lazarus on isawau.)
On rorobun jeverig on dura Iesu aurin siyafar siyau: “Bada, Om turam am nuabo on isawau.”

Iesu on dura itatam mom On iyau, “Atonio sawau on men iniyamai Lazarus inarab on. Ambin on atonio bobo imatar on God an faiwar inboai ingat sabu sinitai, ato on emon on God Natun arimon faiwar inboai.”
Iesu on Martha a tain tuan Mary a Lazarus mat on inuabois.
Baise Iesu on Lazarus isasawau an dura itatam, ato On efan menan imama on nan nana ra ruam ba ima.
Namon On an baigibubunuotis auris iyau, “Ot tanmatabir men tanan au Judea tafanam aurin.”
Baigibubunuotis siyafotai siyau, “Baibebeotim, wera men weromin amonai Jew sabu sigogoi agimai sitrabim ato Om ebinonotim nan unmatabir men unan mes i?”
Iesu iyau, “Ra kaitamom itom amonai wera auyotoat sasagis ruam nanaba yen. On mes orot rai nan inabib on men arimon ann inrugedan inafeu on yabin on atonio tafanam an ratafinai eitai ebibib on mes.
Baise on fom amonai ebibib on ann inrugedan inafeu yabin on aurin tafa ambin.”
Iesu atonio dura ikakafun ato On nana an dura ibotein iyau, “Turat Lazarus on yenbubur, baise Yau anan on arimon anibaban inmisir.”
Baigibubunuotis siyafotai siyau, “Bada, on inembubur mes on arimon inyawas men.”
Lazarus irabob aurin on Iesu ibikakafun baise baigibubunuotis sinos on asir enbubur maiau aurin ebikakafun bait.
On mes Iesu on dura totor wat ikasones iyau, “Lazarus on irabob,
baise Yau abiyasisir omi aurim, yabin Yau on men bisinai, onai omi Yau wonitutumeu. Ot tanan Lazarus aurin.”
Thomas on (seyoyorai Sisiru) on baigibubunuotis tuturan auris iyau, “Ot engon ati baibebeotin mat tanan, onai ot engon On mat tanarab!”
Iesu Toun on Bobaimisir a On Toun on Yawas
Iesu inai igat mom, On isagob Lazarus on sigarobai nono ra bat nanaba isawar.
Bethany inai au Jerusalem on eta men weromin bag kilomita ton nanaba,
ato Jew sabu sigaraba on Jerusalem emon sinat Martha a Mary rus sitites sitkubainunubes mes ato tuas orot irarabob aurin on.
Martha dura itatam Iesu i’nat on, on imisir igat inai On itnefotai mes; baise Mary on goa amonai ima.
Martha on Iesu aurin iyau, “Bada, Om nin utmama on, yau tuau orot on arimon men itarab on!
Baise yau asagob Om on God aurin unbifefeyan on arimon initem.”
Iesu on jever iyawur iyau, “Om tuam orot on arimon inmisir inyawas men.”
Jever iyafotai iyau, “Yau asagob on arimon ra au kanfoun inmisir inyawas men.”
Iesu jever aurin iyau, “Yau Tou on sabu abobaimisires a sabu yawas abites. Iyai iyafan Yau inbitutumeu on arimon inama basit on irabob min on;
ato iyai iyafan yawasin emama a Yau ebitutumeu on arimon men inarab. Om atonio dura aurin min ebitutum i?”
Jever iyafotai iyau, “Bada, dura bag, Yau abitutum Om on Orot Rurubinin God Natun On inat au tafanam.”
Iesu Itou
Martha atonio dura iyau gibunai on imatabir men inai tain tuan Mary aurin nan sunubai aurin iyor. On iyawur iyau, “Baibebeotin atonio inat, ato Om aurim ebitetem.”
Mary atonio dura itatam on imisir ato gagariwat igat inai itnefotai mes.
(Iesu on men inat mafamai irui on, baise On on efan menan Martha inenefotai on nan.)
Jew sabu iyabon Mary mat goa amonai simama sikubainunubai on sit on imisir ato yagiginai nan iyayai igat ato osi on sigibubunuai sigat. Osi sinos on enan au rasi nan inatou bait.
Mary inai Iesu aurin igat, ato on iyeit On i’tai mom on, nanai sindan irou. On iyau, “Bada, Om nin utmama on tuau orot arimon men itarab on!”
Iesu on jever it itotou a On it Jew sabu on mat sinat on sitotou; ato On nunuan amonai wat on men sunub iya komas ato iyababan kwakwan.
Iesu itetemis iyau, “On menan nan wogarobai i?” Osi siyafotai siyau, “Bada, Om enat unitai.”
Iesu itou.
On mes Jew sabu siyau bonen, “Woit, On orot inuaboai kwakwan on mes!”
Baise sabu fani siyau, “On Orot matan fotin ifourai matan iyeit. Ato On aibo mes men bobo aifan tani ifour itiyamai Lazarus on men itarab mes?”
Iesu On Lazarus Rabob emon Ibobaimisirai Iyawas
Iesu nunuanai on men sunub iyababan men, ato On inai au rasi, on rasi min oyau anai bag nan dogu sisar, ato agimai nan on dogu awan siyafotai.
Iesu dura wawaninai sabu iyawures iyau, “Agim woboseir!” Orot rabobin robun Martha on iyafotai iyau, “Baise Bada, on sigarobai i’yen on ra bat isawar, ato yanden on arimon inkomas kwakwan!”
Iesu on jever aurin iyau, “Om min awurem nono, om unbitutum on arimon God an faiwar on unitai.”
Osi agim siboseir. Iesu au safam itage ato iyau, “Tamau, abikakaiwim Om Yau fonau utatam.
Yau asagob Om ra fufur fonau etatam, baise sabu atonio nin auris on mes atonio dura abikakafun, onai osi sinitutum on Om Yau uiyafareu.”
Iesu atonio dura iyau isawar gibunai On fonan gagaminai iyor iyau, “Lazarus, om emisir egat!”

Lazarus on ire goru auman imisir igat, on ann a iman on rasi an beberai sikikimanai a on magin on eb beberai sikikimanai. Iesu sabu iyawures iyau, “On usinai beber worufanen, ato wonikirir inabib inan.”
Iesu Sinbirabobai aurin Sitarasisib
Jew sabu sigaraba sinat Mary sifafasiuai on sit Iesu bobo aifan ifofour on, ato osi On situtumai.
Baise sabu fani on simatabir sirui Pharisee yangan auris ato sikasones bobo aifan Iesu ifofour on.
On mes Pharisee yangan a priest aiwabis on Jew babadis Rurubinis on mat sinat siruayo kuayo kaitamom imatar ato siyau, “Ot aifan taniyamai i? Woit, Orot bobo buburis engon efofour on!

Ot ato nanaba tanikirir bobo buburis nana inafour innanan on, arimon sabu engon tutufin On sinitutumai a Rome yangan asi babadis on arimon sinnat ati tafaror goa a ati tafanam engon tutufin sinikomasen!”
Orot tani wabin Caiaphas, on kwanda amonai on sikutetai Priest Ainauin imama on iyau, “Omi not men aifan tani wosagob on!
Iyobin Orot kaitamom wonboai inarab sabu auris, men sabu engon tutufin sinikomasis mes, baise omi bobo atonio on men wosagob!”
Baise Caiaphas on men toun an notai on dura ikakafun on; ab on kwanda on Priest Ainauin imama ato on God an dura on aurin ibo igat ibikakafun on Iesu inarab Jew yangan auris,
ato men osi ekesis wat auris, baise God an sabu engon fetag fetag sitagege semama on mat inboes sinnat sinikaita kuayo kaitamom sinmatar.
On ra nan on Jew babadis asi bainonot siyamai Iesu sitasubun mes.
On mes Iesu on men wasai nan Judea tafanam amonai ibib on, baise On efan ikirir ato inai efan koiteterin bisinai nan, On inai mafam gagamin wabin Ephraim on nan an baigibubunuotis mat sima.
Jew yangan asi Baisobon An Forag an Ra ibiufin ato sabu sigaraba on tafanam ta ta emon sigai au Jerusalem nan tous sitiyames God matanai sitgumidar weie Forag itbosuruf.
Osi nan Iesu sinunuen, ato osi nan tafaror goai siruayo ato tous wat sibitetem bonen siyau, “Omi mamaba wononosin i? Dura bag On men arimon innat forag aurin on!”
Priest aiwabis a Pharisee yangan on dura wawaninai sabu siyawures on, iyafan insasagob Iesu menan nan on, wonkasonei wansagob ato osi On sifatumai.
